title: Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program Item Price File: Cash Prices and Insulin Units per Billing Unit
content:
A billing unit on the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program is one dispensed package — a 10 mL vial, a box of five 3 mL pens, or a box of 100 pen needles or syringes — except for J1817, whose billing unit is 50 units of insulin. This price file gives, for each item, the Larkfield cash price per billing unit in USD and the units of insulin each billing unit contains. Pen needles and syringes contain no insulin and show 0 units.

The same figures apply on all seven tiers — the Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program, Commercial HMO Program, Commercial PPO Program, Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program, Medicare Part D Program, Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program and Medicaid Program.

| Item | Billing unit | Cash price per billing unit (USD) | Units of insulin per billing unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin lispro, 10 mL vial | one vial | 25.00 | 1000 |
| Insulin aspart, 10 mL vial | one vial | 35.90 | 1000 |
| Insulin lispro pens, box of five 3 mL pens | one box | 45.75 | 1500 |
| Insulin glargine pens, box of five 3 mL pens | one box | 98.40 | 1500 |
| Insulin degludec pens, box of five 3 mL pens | one box | 107.60 | 1500 |
| Human regular insulin, 10 mL vial | one vial | 24.88 | 1000 |
| Pen needles 32G 4 mm, box of 100 | one box | 28.30 | 0 |
| Insulin syringes 31G 0.5 mL, box of 100 | one box | 24.15 | 0 |
| J1817 pump insulin | 50 units of insulin | 2.10 | 50 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical orders)

- Three boxes of insulin glargine pens at the cash price total 98.40 multiplied by 3, which is 295.20.
- Two boxes of pen needles together with one insulin lispro 10 mL vial total 28.30 multiplied by 2, plus 25.00, which is 81.60.
- A 10 mL vial holding 1000 units of insulin corresponds to 1000 divided by 50, that is 20, J1817 billing units of 50 units each; at 2.10 per billing unit those 20 billing units are priced at 42.00.
